facts.evidence: Reported earnings of **$12.1 billion** ($6.11 per share, diluted) for Q2 2026, including a **$230 million asset sale gain** and **$86 million pension settlement costs**; foreign currency effects reduced earnings by **$49 million**.
**Adjusted earnings** were **$12.0 billion** ($6.06 per share, diluted), excluding non-operational items.
**Upstream earnings** of **$8.18 billion** (vs. **$2.73 billion** in Q2 2025), driven by **20% YoY production growth**
**Return on capital employed (ROCE)** was **21.4%** for Q2 2026, up from **6.2%** in Q2 2025.
driven by **20% YoY production growth** (4.07 MBOED vs. 3.396 MBOED), including contributions from **legacy Hess assets**
**Total debt was reduced by $8.4 billion** in Q2 2026, improving the **debt-to-CFFO ratio to 0.8x**
**Dividend declared** at **$1.78 per share**, payable September 10, 2026.

claims.claim: Chevron reported earnings of $12.1 billion for Q2 2026.
claims.note: Release: reported earnings of $12.1 billion ($12,072MM).

claims.claim: Q2 2026 reported earnings were $6.11 per diluted share.
claims.note: Matches income statement diluted EPS of 6.11.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 results included a $230 million asset sale gain.
claims.note: Release text and Attachment 4 (Int'l Downstream asset sale gain $230MM).

claims.claim: Q2 2026 results included $86 million of pension settlement costs.
claims.note: Release text and Attachment 4 after-tax $86MM.

claims.claim: Foreign currency effects reduced Q2 2026 earnings by $49 million.
claims.note: Release: foreign currency effects decreased earnings by $49 million.

claims.claim: Adjusted earnings were $12.0 billion, or $6.06 per diluted share, excluding non-operational items.
claims.note: Release: adjusted earnings $11,977MM / $6.06 per diluted share.

claims.claim: Cash flow from operations was $22.6 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Summary table and Attachment 3 ($22,633MM).

claims.claim: Adjusted free cash flow was $15.4 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Attachment 3: $15,433MM; highlights table $15.4B.

claims.claim: Free cash flow was $18.1 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Attachment 3: $18,095MM; highlights table $18.1B.

claims.claim: ROCE was 21.4% in Q2 2026, up from 6.2% in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Attachment 2 ROCE table.

claims.claim: Total debt was reduced by $8.4 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Release calls it a record $8.4 billion reduction; brief omits 'record' but figure and period are right.

claims.claim: The debt-to-CFFO ratio improved to 0.8x.
claims.note: Highlights table shows 2Q 2026 debt-to-CFFO of 0.8x.

claims.claim: The debt-to-CFFO ratio was 1.2x in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Release shows 0.9x for 2Q 2025; the 1.2x figure is the December 31, 2025 trailing-12-month ratio from Attachment 2, a different period.

claims.claim: Upstream earnings were $8.18 billion in Q2 2026 versus $2.73 billion in Q2 2025.
Worldwide production grew 20% year over year.
claims.note: Release: production 20 percent higher than second quarter last year.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 production was 4.07 MBOED versus 3.396 MBOED in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Values match 4,070 and 3,396 MBOED; the brief's unit label is off by a factor of 1,000 (should be 4,070 MBOED or 4.07 MMBOED).

claims.claim: Production growth included contributions from legacy Hess assets.
claims.note: Release attributes the increase largely to legacy Hess assets.

claims.claim: Production growth included growth in the Permian Basin and the Gulf of Mexico.
claims.note: Release says 'Gulf of America'; substance of the driver is the same, but the brief does not use the release's naming.

claims.claim: U.S. upstream earnings rose to $3.54 billion from $1.42 billion in Q2 2025.
U.S. liquids production was 1.49 MBD, up from 1.22 MBD.
claims.note: Values match 1,491 and 1,218 MBD; unit label off by a factor of 1,000 as written.

claims.claim: U.S. liquids realization was $70.80/BBL versus $47.77/BBL in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Matches U.S. upstream table.

claims.claim: Downstream earnings were $4.87 billion versus $737 million in Q2 2025.
U.S. refinery crude throughput was a record 1.07 million barrels per day.
claims.note: Release: record 1.07 million barrels per day (1,070 MBD); brief's 'MBD' label is loose.

claims.claim: U.S. crude unit utilization was 97 percent.
claims.note: Headline says 97 percent; bullet says more than 97 percent.

claims.claim: U.S. downstream benefited from higher margins on refined product sales.
claims.note: Stated in U.S. downstream bullet.

claims.claim: International downstream earnings improved to $2.46 billion from $333 million in Q2 2025.
International refinery crude unit inputs declined 10% year over year due to Middle East conflict supply disruptions.
claims.note: Stated in international downstream bullet.

claims.claim: The release provides no forward guidance.
claims.note: The release does include forward-looking targets (structural cost reductions of $3-4 billion by end of 2026; Singapore-related sale expected to close in 2027) and refers to a separately published 'Sensitivities and Forward Guidance' document.

claims.claim: Chevron achieved $3 billion of annual run-rate structural cost reductions six months ahead of schedule.
claims.note: Release: achieved its structural cost reduction target six months early by capturing $3 billion in annual run-rate savings.

claims.claim: Chevron delivered $1.5 billion of Hess-related annual run-rate synergies ahead of target.
claims.note: Release: achieved ahead of schedule, exceeding the initial target by 50 percent.

claims.claim: Chevron signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft for approximately 2.67 GW of behind-the-meter power for a West Texas data center.
claims.note: Stated in highlights and business milestones.

claims.claim: Capital expenditures were $4.5 billion in Q2 2026 versus $3.7 billion in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Highlights table; Attachment 2 shows $4,538MM vs $3,712MM.

claims.claim: Higher capex was driven by legacy Hess spend, partially offset by lower Permian Basin spend.
claims.note: Stated in financial highlights bullet.

claims.claim: The net debt-to-CFFO ratio improved to 0.6x.
claims.note: Highlights table 2Q 2026 net debt-to-CFFO 0.6x.

claims.claim: The net debt-to-CFFO ratio was 1.0x in Q2 2025.
claims.note: Release shows 0.8x for 2Q 2025; 1.0x is the December 31, 2025 figure in Attachment 2, a different period.

claims.claim: The Board declared a quarterly dividend of $1.78 per share, payable September 10, 2026.
claims.note: Stated in financial highlights.

claims.claim: Production was curtailed in the Partitioned Zone between Saudi Arabia and Kuwait because of the Middle East conflict.
claims.note: Stated in international upstream bullet.

claims.claim: Chevron's program targets $3-4 billion of structural cost reductions by the end of 2026.
claims.note: Release states the $3-4 billion by end-2026 target; note the brief files it under Hess integration, while the release ties it to the structural cost program measured against 2024 levels, separate from the $1.5B Hess synergies.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 saw a $2.9 billion increase in working capital.
claims.note: Sign is reversed: Attachment 3 shows a $2,945MM net decrease in operating working capital in Q2 2026 (a source of cash), which the release cites as favorable working capital effects.

claims.claim: Q1 2026 saw a $1.7 billion decrease in working capital.
claims.note: The $(1,680)MM figure is the six-month YTD 2026 net increase in operating working capital, not Q1, and the sign is reversed; a Q1-only figure would require a calculation the release does not show.
